# The Towne Tavern (Olympia, WA)

Your neighborhood living room. No pretense. Cold drinks, solid bites, and Olympia's most welcoming scene.

## Essential Info
- **Type**: Bar / Neighborhood Pub
- **Address**: 2020 Pacific Ave SE, Olympia, WA 98506
- **Phone**: +1-360-786-6812
- **Hours**: 10:00 AM - 2:00 AM (7 Days a Week)
- **Cuisine**: Tavern Favorites (Fried Food & NW Craft Taps)
- **Vibe**: Cozy, tight-knit, low-key, established regulars.

## Features
- **Games**: Bar Bingo (Tuesdays), Trivia, Pool, Golden Tee, Pull Tabs.
- **Menu Highlights**: Chicken Strips, Mozzarella Sticks, Hot Fries, NW Craft Taps, Cocktails.
- **Directions**: [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=2020+Pacific+Ave+SE+Olympia+WA+98506)
